finding: RULING (Drew, 2026-09-12 widget): CPA-VF Black & White Red Ink is a 2026 Bowman (paper) card, not Bowman Chrome. The row hiq:baseball:2026:bowman-chrome:cpa-vf:black-white-red-ink:auto (source checklist-drew-ruling-2026-08-30-red-ink) was minted under the wrong product key. The corrected checklist file (same source string, setKey now `bowman`) mints the replacement at hiq:baseball:2026:bowman:cpa-vf:black-white-red-ink:auto. This is a PRODUCT KEY correction of one checklist-authored row, not a fold between two independently-sourced rows — the retired row and its replacement share one authorship (the same drew-ruling source), so there is no player or evidence disagreement to adjudicate; the only defect being corrected is which product the ruling's own checklist evidence actually names.
rulings: A RESLUG was considered and rejected in favor of retire+separate-mint. relocate-catalog-rows-by-list.cjs's reslug path (moveCatalogRow) would carry the row's sales automatically and needs no companion pool list — but a reslug's `to` must not already be occupied, AND the ingest is what mints `to` in the first place: the ingest reads the corrected manifest and writes hiq:baseball:2026:bowman:cpa-vf:black-white-red-ink:auto directly with `authoritativeSetKey: true`, so there is nothing to reslug ONTO before the ingest runs, and once the ingest has run the reslug's destination is already occupied by the freshly-minted checklist row — moveCatalogRow refuses an occupied destination as a matter of course, and even if it did not, folding the corrected write into a reslug would mean maintaining the WRONG row as the source of truth until dispatch, rather than letting the corrected checklist file mint the row directly. Retire+re-mint keeps exactly one write path (the checklist ingest) authoritative for this card's identity.

SALES MUST BE EMPTIED FIRST. This lane's retire is a hard DELETE (catalogVisibility.ts:23-25 — every state is matchable, only visibility is tiered; retireCatalogRow re-points nothing). The companion pool list must have already relocated the one live sale, or this retire would leave it UNPLACED for the rematch instead of resident at the corrected bowman-keyed row.

salesAt (recount) MUST be 0 at the superseded address before this list is dispatched — the runner operator re-verifies with a fresh read-only query against sold_comps WHERE cardId = 'hiq:baseball:2026:bowman-chrome:cpa-vf:black-white-red-ink:auto' immediately before running this list, per the two-HALT discipline for a delete that follows a write it depends on.

The PARKed CardHedge row (cardhedge::1778540428361x447194681698603460::...) is NOT this row's sale and does not block this retire: point-read 2026-09-12 shows its cardId is its own vendor partition and its hobbyiqCardId still names the (already retired) self-derived twin, never this bowman-chrome ruling row. See the companion pool list for the full accounting.

This retire does not touch the CPA-BA sibling row (hiq:baseball:2026:bowman-chrome:cpa-ba:black-white-red-ink:auto, a different card number, Brailyn Antunez) — that row's product placement is unaffected by this correction and is out of scope.
